name: adidas Yeezy 700 V3 'Copper Fade'
story_html: The adidas Yeezy 700 V3 ‘Copper Fade’ carries an upper composed of monofilament engineered mesh in a gradient rust orange hue. The lightweight build is secured with no-tie elastic laces and bolstered with a translucent RPU cage for added structure and durability. Interior bootie construction in a dark brown finish delivers a snug, comfortable fit. The sneaker rides atop a PU-encapsulated EVA midsole, reinforced underfoot by a grippy herringbone-traction rubber outsole.
